text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Algeria's Hamas Islamist party changes name and announces its participation in the legislative elections to be held on June 5. Hamas's leader Mahfoud Nahnah says the party undertook the change to underscore its non-violent policy.
- Government, workers' and business representatives to meet on April 24 over pay hike and other social issues.
- Hamas was renamed Movement of a Peaceful Society.
- Main private business union backs worker salary increase.
- President Liamine Zeroual issues an order urging the administration and political parties to help one another in order to ensure transparency and fairness for the parliamentary poll.
- Salah Boubnider, head of an independent committee to supervise the legislative elections, starts meetings with opposition leaders to rally support for his watchdog body.
